name: smwmusic-ape-escape
title: Ape Escape 3 - Fantasy Knight
description:
This song plays during the Fantasy Knight transformation in Ape Escape 3. It's a repetitive, yet catchy tune. It's fairly short, so it's probably not a good idea to use it in long levels. I'd say it's best suited for an overworld, bonus room, or cut scene.
